issue.title: Add /start-issue delivery loop and shared agent command surface
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Agent delivery in fluent-mobile is split across Cursor slash commands (`/create-pr-branch`, `/create-pr`, `/generate-pr-description`) with no single issue → branch → implement → PR loop. Commands live only under `.cursor/commands/`; Claude Code has no command surface besides `pr-demo-video`.

This ticket adds a shared agent command surface: canonical instructions under `.claude/commands/`, thin Cursor `/` shims, `/start-issue` for the full delivery graph, a stronger `/create-pr` handoff (code-reviewer, Project 4 **In PR Review**, CI watch), plus a Fluent-specific `code-reviewer` agent and a small set of skills.

## Current vs expected

**Current**
- Six Cursor-only slash commands; no `/start-issue`
- `/create-pr` does not run a convention reviewer, does not move Project 4 to **In PR Review**, and does not watch CI to green
- `.claude/` has only `skills/pr-demo-video/`

**Expected**
- `/start-issue NNN` claims the ticket, sets **In Progress (Dev)**, cuts a branch from `main` using existing naming, plan-gates large work, implements to AC, then chains to `/create-pr`
- `/create-pr` (alias `/open-pr`) hard-blocks on CI gates, runs `code-reviewer`, opens a draft PR with `Refs #NNN`, sets **In PR Review**, watches CI; never merges; never uses closing keywords
- Cursor shims point at `.claude/commands/`; always-on rules stay in `.cursor/rules/`

## Scope

**In scope**
- Move existing six command bodies to `.claude/commands/` with thin Cursor shims
- Add `/start-issue` and `/open-pr` alias
- Strengthen `/create-pr` (reviewer, board move, CI watch)
- Add `ai-tooling-bridge` + `pr-delivery-ci-gate` Cursor rules
- Add `.claude/agents/code-reviewer.md` (Fluent architecture / Android-only / theme / `Refs`)
- Add `sync-claude-primitives` and `write-test` skills adapted to this repo
- Warn-only hook for `fetch(` / raw SQL in `src/app/` and `src/components/`
- Update `docs/issue-tracking.md`, `docs/AGENT_ONBOARDING.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `commands.mdc`, `delivery.mdc`

**Out of scope**
- Release-train / iOS run commands
- Changing CI to changed-files-only lint
- Moving the PR template out of `.cursor/templates/`
- Scaffolding skills for other app architectures

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `/start-issue NNN` and `/create-pr` (plus `/open-pr` alias) work from Cursor's `/` palette and by reading `.claude/commands/`
- [ ] Existing six commands still appear in Cursor; logic lives once under `.claude/`
- [ ] `/create-pr` sets Project 4 Status to **In PR Review** (best-effort) and watches CI; never merges; `Refs #NNN` only
- [ ] `/start-issue` respects Project 4 hard rules (no Product-column edits; `In Progress (Dev)` for the assigned ticket)
- [ ] Docs + `commands.mdc` list the new loop
- [ ] CI gates pass (`format:check`, `lint`, `typecheck`, `npm test -- --ci`)

## Verification / test plan

1. Confirm Cursor `/` palette lists `/start-issue`, `/open-pr`, and the existing six commands
2. Read `.claude/commands/start-issue.md` and `.claude/commands/create-pr.md` — Fluent facts only (`main`, `Refs`, Project 4, npm, Android-only)
3. Run CI command order from `.cursor/rules/commands.mdc`

## Links

- Board: [Fluent Mobile Board](https://github.com/orgs/eten-tech-foundation/projects/4/views/9)
- Delivery: `.cursor/rules/delivery.mdc`
- Board rules: `docs/guides/project-board.md`
